body:
# BountyHunt
[![minecraft-title.png](https://i.postimg.cc/yNQJKz7c/minecraft-title.png)](https://postimg.cc/sBWfPqQg)
![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-blue)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Paper%201.21+-green)

Advanced Player Bounty System for your Minecraft server. 

## Features
- **Player Bounties**: Set, claim, and track player bounties.
- **Economy Integration**: Seamless integration with Vault-supported economy plugins.
- **PlaceholderAPI**: Display bounty information in scores, scoreboard, or chat.
- **Insurance**: Protect yourself against lost items when bounty is claimed.
- **Reputation**: Track player reputation based on bounty actions.
- **Escalation**: Dynamic bounty escalation management.
- **SQLite Storage**: Persistent storage using SQLite.

## Commands
- `/bounty`: Main command to access the bounty interface and tools.

## Dependencies
- **Vault** (Required for economy)
- **PlaceholderAPI** (Optional, recommended for better integration)

## Installation
1. Drop the `BountyHunt-1.0.0.jar` into your `plugins` folder.
2. Restart your server.
3. Configure settings in `plugins/BountyHunt/config.yml`.
